events.title: Hugging Face adds a decision-model interface for structured choices
events.title_zh: Hugging Face 新增决策模型接口
events.summary: Hugging Face introduced a common interface for decision models. These models return choices, scores, booleans or multi-select results with probabilities over dynamic options, instead of generating text and parsing JSON. The public example uses Transformers pipeline("decision") with GEV-26B-Decide.
events.why_it_matters: For routing, review and rule-assisted systems, direct option probabilities can reduce text-parsing failures while preserving uncertainty. The interface and models are new, so calibration and out-of-set behavior need local testing.
events.summary_zh: Hugging Face 为 decision model 引入统一接口。模型直接在动态候选项上返回 choice、score、boolean 或多选结果及概率，不必先生成文本再解析 JSON。公开示例通过 Transformers 的 `pipeline("decision")` 调用 GEV-26B-Decide。
events.summary_en: Hugging Face introduced a common interface for decision models. These models return choices, scores, booleans or multi-select results with probabilities over dynamic options, instead of generating text and parsing JSON. The public example uses Transformers pipeline("decision") with GEV-26B-Decide.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对路由、审核和规则辅助系统来说，直接得到候选概率能减少文本解析失败并保留不确定性；接口与模型仍新，概率校准和越界候选需要本地验证。
events.why_it_matters_en: For routing, review and rule-assisted systems, direct option probabilities can reduce text-parsing failures while preserving uncertainty. The interface and models are new, so calibration and out-of-set behavior need local testing.

technical_details.evidence_limit: announcement explains interface; no independent production evaluation

events.next_action_zh: 用公开模型跑一组路由样本，校准置信度并测试候选项动态增删和未知类别。
events.next_action_en: Run the public model on routing samples, calibrating confidence and testing dynamic options and unknown categories.

events.title: Google and Artificial Analysis launch a multimodal knowledge-work benchmark
events.title_zh: Google 与 Artificial Analysis 发布多模态知识工作评测
events.summary: The Multimodal Knowledge Agent benchmark evaluates agents on 200 private tasks spanning 10 verticals and 83 occupations, using documents, charts, images and spreadsheets. Models run with the same open-source Stirrup harness, tools, sandbox and turn budget, and 10 public tasks expose the format.
events.why_it_matters: For teams selecting knowledge-work agents, this is closer to everyday deliverables than text-only QA. The full 200-task set is private, and the claimed 96% human agreement for the autorater still needs scrutiny of samples and error distributions.
events.summary_zh: Multimodal Knowledge Agent benchmark 用 200 个跨 10 个行业、83 种职业的私有任务评测 agent 处理文档、图表、图片和表格的能力。所有模型使用同一开源 Stirrup harness、工具、沙箱和 turn budget；另有 10 个公开任务可检查格式。
events.summary_en: The Multimodal Knowledge Agent benchmark evaluates agents on 200 private tasks spanning 10 verticals and 83 occupations, using documents, charts, images and spreadsheets. Models run with the same open-source Stirrup harness, tools, sandbox and turn budget, and 10 public tasks expose the format.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对选型知识工作 agent 的团队来说，这比纯文本问答更接近日常交付物；完整 200 题闭集不可下载，自动评分与 96% 人类一致率仍需看报告中的样本和误差分布。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams selecting knowledge-work agents, this is closer to everyday deliverables than text-only QA. The full 200-task set is private, and the claimed 96% human agreement for the autorater still needs scrutiny of samples and error distributions.

events.title: NVIDIA donates Agent Substrate for checkpointed Kubernetes agent sessions
events.title_zh: NVIDIA 捐出可检查点恢复的 Agent Substrate
events.summary: NVIDIA donated Agent Substrate to the CNCF Sandbox. The open-source runtime multiplexes many agent sessions over a small pool of Kubernetes worker Pods, checkpointing memory and filesystems while idle and restoring them for the next step. NVIDIA claims 10x container density and million-agent scale.
events.why_it_matters: For platform teams running many intermittent coding agents or RL workers, this separates session state from Pod lifetime. Scale and security claims remain NVIDIA-reported, and CNCF Sandbox status does not establish production maturity.
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 将 Agent Substrate 捐入 CNCF Sandbox。该开源 runtime 在少量 Kubernetes worker Pod 上复用大量 agent session，并在空闲时保存内存与文件系统，下一步到来时恢复到可用 worker。NVIDIA 称密度可达标准容器的 10 倍，并面向百万级 agent 与工具。
events.summary_en: NVIDIA donated Agent Substrate to the CNCF Sandbox. The open-source runtime multiplexes many agent sessions over a small pool of Kubernetes worker Pods, checkpointing memory and filesystems while idle and restoring them for the next step. NVIDIA claims 10x container density and million-agent scale.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对需要大量间歇式 coding agent 或 RL worker 的平台团队来说，这把会话状态与 Pod 生命周期拆开；规模和安全主张仍来自 NVIDIA，CNCF Sandbox 也不等于生产成熟。
events.why_it_matters_en: For platform teams running many intermittent coding agents or RL workers, this separates session state from Pod lifetime. Scale and security claims remain NVIDIA-reported, and CNCF Sandbox status does not establish production maturity.

technical_details.architecture: checkpoint memory and filesystem, multiplex sessions over worker Pods, restore on demand
technical_details.publisher_claim: up to 10x density and millions of agents/tools
technical_details.evidence_limit: scale and security claims are publisher-reported; no independent deployment results

technical_details_zh.证据限制: 规模与安全主张来自发布方；没有独立部署结果

events.next_action_en: Within one day, deploy the public single-node example and measure idle memory, restore latency, filesystem consistency and tenant isolation.

events.title: NVIDIA Snapshot restores initialized GPU inference workloads in seconds
events.title_zh: NVIDIA Snapshot 在数十秒内恢复 GPU 推理任务
events.summary: NVIDIA Snapshot open-sources checkpoint and restore for initialized Kubernetes GPU workloads, including CPU and GPU memory state. NVIDIA reports 3.6-42.7 second restores on B200 with VAST NFS, 8-36x faster than cold start, with checkpoints up to about 1 TB across eight GPUs.
events.why_it_matters: For elastic-inference and recovery teams, it may materially reduce large-model scale-up delay. Results depend on NVIDIA GPUs, high-performance storage and specific engines and must be reproduced on the target network and storage stack.
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA Snapshot 开源了 Kubernetes GPU workload 的检查点与恢复组件，可保存已初始化的 CPU/GPU 内存状态。NVIDIA 在 B200 与 VAST NFS 上报告 3.6–42.7 秒恢复，较冷启动快 8–36 倍，并支持八张 GPU、最高约 1 TB 的 checkpoint。
events.summary_en: NVIDIA Snapshot open-sources checkpoint and restore for initialized Kubernetes GPU workloads, including CPU and GPU memory state. NVIDIA reports 3.6-42.7 second restores on B200 with VAST NFS, 8-36x faster than cold start, with checkpoints up to about 1 TB across eight GPUs.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对弹性推理与故障恢复团队来说，它可能显著缩短大模型扩容等待；结果依赖 NVIDIA GPU、高性能存储和特定 engine，必须在自己的网络与存储上重测。
events.why_it_matters_en: For elastic-inference and recovery teams, it may materially reduce large-model scale-up delay. Results depend on NVIDIA GPUs, high-performance storage and specific engines and must be reproduced on the target network and storage stack.

technical_details.scale: checkpoints up to about 1 TB across eight GPUs
technical_details.test_stack: NVIDIA B200 with VAST NFS; multiple inference engines
technical_details.evidence_limit: publisher benchmark; storage and engine dependent

technical_details_zh.测试栈: NVIDIA B200 + VAST NFS；多种推理 engine
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 发布方 benchmark；高度依赖存储与 engine

events.next_action_zh: 用一套现有模型和目标存储复测 checkpoint 大小、创建时间、恢复延迟与首请求正确性。
events.next_action_en: Re-test one existing model on the target storage, measuring checkpoint size, creation time, restore latency and first-request correctness.

events.title: NVIDIA previews open Kubernetes management and build tools for AI factories
events.title_zh: NVIDIA 预览 AI 工厂 Kubernetes 管理与构建工具
events.summary: NVIDIA released NVKE and NVKR as Apache 2.0 public previews. NVKR builds node images, containers and packages from version-pinned sources; NVKE uses REST APIs and management-cluster controllers to create, upgrade and operate customer Kubernetes clusters. NVIDIA says APIs and behavior may change and does not recommend production use.
events.why_it_matters: For platform teams building GPU clouds and AI factories, this provides an inspectable managed-Kubernetes control plane and reproducible build chain. Preview API stability and operational boundaries remain unsuitable for production commitments.
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 以 Apache 2.0 发布 NVKE 与 NVKR public preview。NVKR 从固定版本来源构建节点镜像、容器和软件包；NVKE 通过 REST API 和管理集群控制器创建、升级并运营客户 Kubernetes 集群。官方明确 APIs 与行为可能变化，暂不建议生产使用。
events.summary_en: NVIDIA released NVKE and NVKR as Apache 2.0 public previews. NVKR builds node images, containers and packages from version-pinned sources; NVKE uses REST APIs and management-cluster controllers to create, upgrade and operate customer Kubernetes clusters. NVIDIA says APIs and behavior may change and does not recommend production use.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对建设 GPU 云与 AI factory 的平台团队来说，这提供了可检查的 managed Kubernetes 控制面与可复现构建链；预览阶段的 API 稳定性和运维边界仍不适合生产承诺。
events.why_it_matters_en: For platform teams building GPU clouds and AI factories, this provides an inspectable managed-Kubernetes control plane and reproducible build chain. Preview API stability and operational boundaries remain unsuitable for production commitments.

events.title: Microsoft shows that editing seven dormant neurons can backdoor AI agents
events.title_zh: Microsoft 发现修改 7 个休眠神经元即可给 AI agent 植入后门
events.summary: Microsoft researchers show that Lazarus can edit fewer than ten dormant neurons without retraining, making an otherwise normal model emit an attacker payload when a trigger appears. The public study covers three models and three agent scaffolds, and includes code. The paper demonstrates triggered payload generation in recorded contexts, not complete real-world attacks.
events.summary_en: Microsoft researchers show that Lazarus can edit fewer than ten dormant neurons without retraining, making an otherwise normal model emit an attacker payload when a trigger appears. The public study covers three models and three agent scaffolds, and includes code. The paper demonstrates triggered payload generation in recorded contexts, not complete real-world attacks.
events.summary_zh: Microsoft 研究者展示了 Lazarus：无需重新训练，只修改不到 10 个休眠神经元，就能让原本表现正常的模型在触发条件出现时输出攻击载荷。公开研究覆盖 3 个模型、3 种 agent scaffold，并提供代码。论文验证的是记录上下文中的载荷触发，不是完整的真实攻击链。
events.why_it_matters: For teams deploying open or internally trained weights behind tools, checkpoint provenance and integrity become part of the agent security boundary. The detector is promising but was tested only against the same edit family, so it is evidence rather than a guarantee.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams deploying open or internally trained weights behind tools, checkpoint provenance and integrity become part of the agent security boundary. The detector is promising but was tested only against the same edit family, so it is evidence rather than a guarantee.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对把开放权重或自研权重接到工具上的团队来说，checkpoint 来源与完整性也属于 agent 安全边界。检测器结果有价值，但只测试了同类修改，不能当成安全保证。

technical_details.attack: 7 of 12,000+ neurons; 23 trigger/no-trigger trajectories; at least 98.8% triggered held-out trajectories on Nemotron; zero observed leakage on evaluated benign trajectories
technical_details.detector: 91.4% of edited test checkpoints flagged at 9.7% false positives; 35 edited and 31 clean test checkpoints
technical_details.evidence_limit: Recorded contexts rather than complete free-acting attacks; detector evaluated against the same edit family; Microsoft reports no observed threat-actor weaponization

technical_details_zh.攻击实验: 12,000 多个神经元中修改 7 个；23 条有/无触发轨迹；Nemotron 在留出触发轨迹中至少 98.8% 输出载荷；评测的正常轨迹中未观察到泄漏
technical_details_zh.检测实验: 35 个修改 checkpoint 与 31 个干净 checkpoint 的测试中，检出 91.4%，误报 9.7%
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 验证的是记录上下文，不是完整自主攻击；检测器只对同类编辑测试；Microsoft 表示尚未观察到攻击者实际利用
technical_details_zh.时间依据: Microsoft Research 页面元数据为 2026-11-10T20:52:56Z

events.next_action_zh: 在接入高权限工具前校验权重来源与 hash，并等跨编辑方法的独立检测复现后再采用自动扫描。
events.next_action_en: Verify weight provenance and hashes before privileged tool access, and wait for independent detection across edit families before adopting automated scanning.

evidence.claim_zh: 公开论文与代码展示少量神经元修改可触发 agent 载荷，并给出同类编辑的检测实验。
evidence.claim_en: The public paper and code show that editing a few neurons can trigger agent payloads and report detection results for the same edit family.

changes.summary_en: Microsoft publishes the Lazarus weight-backdoor study and code.
